retrievals.note: Retrieval dates record when this report observed a source. They are separate from generated_at (report compilation), from publication dates, from event dates, and from CISA date_added values. A null retrieved_at means the calendar day was retained and the clock time was not.

kev_catalog.note: catalog_version is the catalog's own version string. date_added on each kev_additions row is CISA's catalog-addition date. retrieved_on is the calendar day this report read the catalog. The retrieval clock was not retained.

exploitation_status.note: Each top10 exploitation value is the public status observed on retrieved_on from the cited sources. It is not generated_at, not a vulnerability publication date, and not an event date. NONE_KNOWN means the cited sources did not establish exploitation on that retrieval; it is not proof of absence.

x_posts.note: likes_at_fetch is the like count at retrieval. created_at is the poster's publication time. The newest cited created_at is 2026-10-25T01:09:29Z, so retrieval was not earlier than that publication. The exact retrieval clock was not retained.

hub_snapshot.note: snapshot_generated_at is the hub file's own generation time, as cited by this report. read_on is the calendar day this report used that file. The clock at which the file was read was not retained.

feed_sweep.note: Headline counts from the public RSS sweep observed on this calendar day. The retrieval clock was not retained. Feed item publication dates remain on the source items and are not restated here.

exploitation_labels.CONFIRMED: Vendor, CISA KEV or primary research confirms in-the-wild exploitation/compromise
exploitation_labels.REPORTED: Attempts or claims; no primary confirmation of successful exploitation
exploitation_labels.NONE_KNOWN: No public exploitation report in the sources reviewed on the 2026-10-25 retrieval. This is not proof of absence.

top10.title: PHP2Shell: pre-auth RCE in PHP core
mitigations: Take PHP<=8.1 or unpatchable systems offline (CISA)
top10.uncertainty: Attempts since 2026-10-17 (Amazon); CISA had not observed successful exploitation at publication. CVE-2026-115560 had no CVE record at fetch time.

top10.title: ConnectWise supply-chain compromise attributed to Storm-0940 (ARTEX agentic AI)
products: ConnectWise Cloud Backup / SaaS Security / Cloud Management multi-tenant apps; Microsoft Entra tenants
mitigations: Do not delete enterprise apps first; preserve evidence
Search by application ID across tenants
top10.uncertainty: Microsoft: attempted sign-in to >2,250 tenants (not 2,250 breached). Spray Oct 10-14 had no successful auth per Microsoft.

top10.title: eMudhra intermediate CA private keys compromised (weak key generation)
products: eMudhra emSign G3 intermediates (6 TLS, 2 code-signing); trust stores
mitigations: Update browsers, OS trust stores, runtimes and CA bundles (incl. containers/appliances)
top10.uncertainty: Key compromise confirmed; no primary report of misissued certificates used in attacks. Go CVE-2026-111943 is an unverified X claim.

top10.title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 trojanized on PyPI and Docker
mitigations: Find all copies (caches, mirrors, lockfiles, images); pin by digest
Isolate hosts; do not run python; rebuild
Rotate secrets from clean machine; revoke sessions
top10.uncertainty: Published ~11:40 UTC Oct 21; PyPI frozen 13:23 UTC, images removed 14:20 UTC. No second stage confirmed (Microsoft).

top10.title: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL injection zero-day
top10.uncertainty: Advisory page returned HTTP 406 to fetcher; bounds and exploitation confirmed by reviewer and KEV.

top10.title: Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server (Nextcloud richdocumentscode) command injection
mitigations: Upgrade richdocumentscode to >=26.4.303 or remove it; disabling alone is not sufficient
top10.uncertainty: Exploitable only while built-in CODE server is not running.

top10.title: Plex2Shell chain plus SiteGuard and Siemens Software Center added to KEV
products: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition
mitigations: Update Plex Media Server; limit internet exposure
top10.uncertainty: Exact fixed Plex build not verified.

top10.title: PAN-OS GlobalProtect CVE-2026-0257 exploited by Qilin and INC
mitigations: Dedicated cert for Authentication Override cookies or disable Authentication Override
top10.uncertainty: In KEV since 2026-05-29 with known ransomware use.

top10.title: #StopRansomware: SafePay (AA26-293A)
products: Edge VPN and backup products per advisory
mitigations: Alert on new admin accounts and security-tool tampering
top10.uncertainty: ~600 critical-infrastructure victims figure is from secondary reporting.

top10.title: GitLab unauthenticated RCE (Onigmo regex integer overflow)
products: GitLab self-managed, versions back to 7.0; Ruby Onigmo
mitigations: Upgrade GitLab again even if patched Oct 12
top10.uncertainty: GitLab has not described the required conditions.
